name: Wingslash
body:
Your wing talons are deadly weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Winged Heritor, Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), zvarr, stretched wings racial trait, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): You gain two wing attacks. These are secondary natural weapons that deal 1d3 points of slashing damage.
